name: BEW Engineering Ltd.
summary: BEW Engineering Limited engages in the design and manufacture of filters and dryers for the chemicals industry in India. Its products include agitated pressure nutsche filter dryer, pressure nutsche filter, rotocone vacuum dryer, rotocone vacuum filter dryer, cantilever rotocone vacuum dryer, continuous paddle dryer, retractable plough shear mixer dryer, vacuum tray dryer, agitated pan dryer, air tray dryer, conical helix blender cum dryer, rotary vacuum paddle dryer, octagonal blender, plough shear mixer dryer, multimill, comil, vibro shifter, heat exchangers, pressure vessel/storage tanks/receiver, and spherical dryer. The company’s industrial dryers are used in pharmaceutical, chemical, wastewater treatment, dye, and paint industries. It also exports its products. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is based in Dombivli, India.
